unverified additional inputs or external.independent_derivation: No external user fixture or actual-version creation premise is needed for a recorded requested-target map once the frozen source and complete valid Release domain are pinned. However exact backend population, source/identifier bindings, field/scorer typing, completeness, and mapping of these independently derived units to a proposed repaired query must still be verified. A domain-complete map with explicit empty collections and a positive-pairs-only relation are information-equivalent only if the latter also declares the full release domain and explicitly defines omitted domain members as empty. Without that domain/empty convention, absent releases are unspecified, so the two outputs are not automatically equivalent. Empty means no qualifying recorded relation in this dataset, not proof that the release underwent no real-world changes.
